claim: One Application Load Balancer LCU includes 25 new connections per second; for HTTPS listeners this figure applies to RSA certificates with a key size of 2K or less and ECDSA certificates with a key size of 256 or less.

qualifiers.condition: HTTPS listeners: RSA key size 2K or less, ECDSA key size 256 or less; larger keys are covered in the pricing FAQs

evidence.quote: Note 1: For HTTPS listeners, 25 new connections/sec for LCU computation is applicable for RSA certificates with key size <=2K and ECDSA certificates with key size <=256.
